sentences.text: In short: THOMSEN AGENTURER AS is an established company in "agenturhandel med møbler, husholdningsvarer og jernvarer" based in Bergen, profitable in 2025.

THOMSEN AGENTURER AS is registered in the industry "Agenturhandel med møbler, husholdningsvarer og jernvarer"; its registered activity is "Agenturvirksomhet og konsulentvirksomhet, samt handel, markedsføring, deltakelse i andre sel- skaper med økonomisk virksomhet, og det som hermed står i forbindelse.".
THOMSEN AGENTURER AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 1991-06-07, registered in Bergen.
It reported revenue of NOK 263,673 for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 49,460 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 18.8% and a strong equity ratio of 97% of total assets.

Revenue fell 3.2% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 272,473 to NOK 263,673); it was NOK 318,450 in 2023. The annual result was a profit in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: NOK 77,258, 2024: NOK 42,659, 2025: NOK 37,553).
THOMSEN AGENTURER AS is led by CEO Kjartan Keech Haaland and board chair Even Langeland Strand Thomsen.
It has a board of 3. The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-04-14 (within the past year).
THOMSEN AGENTURER AS has 1 registered workplace.
